title: Add a bulk profile update endpoint
task: DX-101: Let a user update several profile fields in one request
Changing display name, timezone and locale currently takes three round
trips. Product wants a single PATCH that accepts all of them.
1. A user may update ONLY their own profile. A request for another
2. Only display_name, timezone and locale may be changed. Any other
field in the request body must be rejected with 400.
3. display_name keeps its existing 1-80 character validation.
4. A database failure must surface as a 5xx, not a 200.
